Amazon cargo plane crashes in Miami, killing five

A Boeing 767 cargo plane operated by 21 Air and carrying Amazon Air freight crashed while attempting to land at Miami International Airport on Sunday. The aircraft overshot the runway, resulting in the deaths of at least five people and injuring five others. Investigators are examining the circumstances of the crash to determine what went wrong. Fire rescue officials described the situation as "very complex."
